_doc.purpose: Undated base-rate shocks that can hit any country in the game in any year. Each year every country draws each kind once from a hash of the game's seed, the country, the kind and the year (no shared dice, so adding a country changes no other country's draws).
_doc.fields: kind: the event kind written to the world event log. annual_chance: the chance a country is hit in a year. population_loss: the share of the country's people lost when it is hit. cause: the cause written on the event. status, source, retire: the label of the figures (CLAUDE.md 4.4).
_doc.famine_food_shortfall: A country whose people leave this share of their food need unmet in a year has a famine written to the event log. A recording threshold, not a mechanism: the deaths come from the strata's own famine death rate.
_doc.event_log_years_kept: How many years of world events a save keeps.

famine_food_shortfall.source: A cut-off for what counts as a famine worth recording; the sources name no common threshold (the IPC famine phase uses a fifth of households with extreme food gaps, a different measure).

hazards.source: Order of a damaging river flood per country per generation; no per-tile flood frequency layer exists yet, so the rate is not read from the tiles.
Order of a destructive earthquake per country per two centuries; no seismic layer exists in the map data yet, so the rate is not read from the tiles.
Order of a ruinous reign per country per century; no succession model draws rulers yet.
